def display_sample_count(traces: List[CallTrace], stderr: IO[str]) -> None:
    # Group traces by function
    traces_by_func = collections.defaultdict(int)
    for trace in traces:
        func = trace.func
        # Get the fully qualified name of the function
        func_module = func.__module__
        func_name = func.__qualname__
        func_key = f"{func_module}.{func_name}"
        traces_by_func[func_key] += 1
    
    # Print in order of first appearance
    seen = set()
    for trace in traces:
        func = trace.func
        func_module = func.__module__
        func_name = func.__qualname__
        func_key = f"{func_module}.{func_name}"
        
        if func_key not in seen:
            seen.add(func_key)
            count = traces_by_func[func_key]
            print(f"Annotation for {func_key} based on {count} call trace(s).", file=stderr)
